5	/**
6	 * Updates the session on every request to prevent session expiry.
7	 *
8	 * CRITICAL: This function rewrites cookies on BOTH the request (for downstream
9	 * reads in the same request cycle) AND the response (for the browser to send
10	 * the updated session token on the next request).
11	 *
12	 * This is the Next.js 16 pattern — proxy.ts calls this, not middleware.ts.
13	 */
14	export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
15	  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })
16	
17	  const supabase = createServerClient<Database>(
18	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
19	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
20	    {
21	      cookies: {
22	        getAll() {
23	          return request.cookies.getAll()
24	        },
25	        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
26	          // Write on the request so downstream server components can read it
27	          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) => request.cookies.set(name, value))
28	          // Rebuild the response with the updated request cookies
29	          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })
30	          // Write on the response so the browser stores the refreshed token
31	          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
32	            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options)
33	          )
34	        },
35	      },
36	    }
37	  )
38	
39	  // IMPORTANT: Always use getUser() — never getSession() for auth checks.
40	  // getUser() validates the JWT against the Supabase server.
41	  const {
42	    data: { user },
43	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
44	
45	  const path = request.nextUrl.pathname
46	
47	  // Redirect unauthenticated users away from protected routes

51	      path.startsWith('/calendar') ||
52	      path.startsWith('/appointments') ||

6	/**
7	 * Next.js 16 middleware — renamed from middleware.ts to proxy.ts.
8	 *
9	 * Runs on every matched request to:
10	 * 1. Handle custom domain rewrites (verified domains only — host header attack prevention)
11	 * 2. Refresh the Supabase session.
12	 * 3. Redirect unauthenticated requests to protected routes → /login.
13	 */
14	export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
15	  const host = request.headers.get('host') ?? ''
16	  const appHost = new URL(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3000').host
17	
18	  // Custom domain rewrite — only runs when the host is NOT the primary app host
19	  // This prevents host header injection: we verify the domain exists and is verified in DB
20	  if (host && host !== appHost && !host.startsWith('localhost')) {
21	    const supabase = createServerClient<Database>(
22	      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
23	      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
24	      {
25	        cookies: {
26	          getAll() {
27	            return request.cookies.getAll()
28	          },
29	          // Read-only in middleware domain check — no cookie writes needed here
30	          setAll() {},
31	        },
32	      },
33	    )
34	
35	    // Only rewrite if the custom_domain is verified — never rewrite unverified domains
36	    const { data: studio } = await supabase
37	      .from('studios')
38	      .select('slug')
39	      .eq('custom_domain', host)
40	      .eq('custom_domain_verified', true)
41	      .eq('white_label_enabled', true)
42	      .maybeSingle()
43	
44	    if (studio?.slug) {
45	      const url = request.nextUrl.clone()
46	      // Rewrite to the public booking page for this studio
47	      url.pathname = `/book/${studio.slug}${url.pathname === '/' ? '' : url.pathname}`
48	      return NextResponse.rewrite(url)
49	    }
50	
51	    // Domain not found or not verified — return 404 to prevent info leakage
52	    if (!host.endsWith(`.${appHost}`)) {
53	      return new NextResponse('Not found', { status: 404 })
54	    }
55	  }
56	
57	  return updateSession(request)
58	}
